name: Advanced Widget Kit for Elementor
author: ainixit

sections.description:
Advanced Widget Kit is a comprehensive collection of powerful widgets for Elementor that helps you create stunning websites without any coding knowledge. This plugin extends Elementor with advanced widgets and templates to enhance your web design capabilities.

🚀 FREE WIDGETS INCLUDED

  • Advanced Button – Create beautiful buttons with gradients, icons, and hover effects
  • Testimonial Widget – Display customer reviews with 6 design styles, dynamic posts, carousel, and configurable star ratings
  • Advanced Posts Widget – Display posts from any post type with grid/list/masonry layouts and AJAX pagination
  • Pricing Table – Showcase your pricing plans with attractive layouts
  • Image Box – Interactive image boxes with hover effects and overlay content
  • Icon List – Create feature lists with custom icons and styling options
  • Advanced Header – Sticky navigation with logo, menu, and CTA support
  • Advanced Heading – Text effects, animations, and hover effects
  • Advanced Carousel – 6 layout types with smart navigation system
  • Advanced Image Gallery – Masonry/grid layouts with lightbox and filtering
  • Advanced Contact Form – Comprehensive form with 50+ styling controls and Voice Input support
  • Advanced Social Icons – Social media icons with multiple styles

✨ KEY FEATURES

  • Custom Post Types Manager – Create and manage custom post types with 8 custom field types (no coding required!)
  • Custom Fields System – Text, Textarea, Number, Email, URL, Select, True/False, Image fields with validation
  • Voice Input System – Speech-to-text for contact forms, comments, and search with 24+ languages and auto-punctuation
  • Dynamic Content – Pull testimonials and posts from any custom post type
  • 6 Design Patterns – Multiple pre-designed layouts for testimonials
  • Easy to Use – Simple drag and drop interface
  • Fully Responsive – Works perfectly on all devices
  • Customizable – Extensive styling options for each widget (100+ controls)
  • Performance Optimized – Lightweight and fast loading
  • Translation Ready – Compatible with WPML and other translation plugins
  • Regular Updates – Continuous improvements and new features

🎯 PERFECT FOR

  • Web Designers
  • Digital Agencies
  • Freelancers
  • Business Owners
  • Bloggers
  • Anyone using Elementor

💎 PRO VERSION FEATURES

  • 15+ Premium Widgets including Advanced Posts Grid, WooCommerce Products, Contact Forms, Countdown Timer, 3D Slider, and more
  • Premium Templates – Ready-to-use page templates
  • Advanced Styling Options – More customization possibilities
  • Priority Support – Get help when you need it
  • Regular Updates – New widgets and features added regularly

Upgrade to Pro →

  • PHP 7.4 or higher

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Advanced Widget Kit for Elementor “
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the downloaded zip file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin

After Installation

  1. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated
  2. Go to Advanced Widget Kit for Elementor → Dashboard to access the dashboard
  3. Enable the widgets you want to use
  4. Start using the widgets in Elementor editor
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes! Advanced Widget Kit for Elementor offers 5 powerful widgets completely free. We also offer a Pro version with additional premium widgets and features.

Do I need Elementor Pro?

No, Advanced Widget Kit for Elementor works with both free and Pro versions of Elementor.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

Not at all! Advanced Widget Kit for Elementor is built with performance in mind. Only the CSS and JS files of enabled widgets are loaded, ensuring optimal performance.

Can I use Advanced Widget Kit for Elementor with any WordPress theme?

Yes, Advanced Widget Kit for Elementor works with any WordPress theme that supports Elementor.

How do I get support?

For free version support, please use the WordPress.org support forum. Pro users get priority support through our dedicated support system.

Can I disable widgets I don’t use?

Absolutely! You can enable or disable individual widgets from the Advanced Widget Kit for Elementor dashboard to optimize performance.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes, Advanced Widget Kit for Elementor is fully translation ready and compatible with WPML and other translation plugins.

How often do you update the plugin?

We release updates regularly with bug fixes, improvements, and new features. The plugin includes an automatic update system.
